description: Inspect publishers and licenses in the DatoQA-approved source registry. Returns items with source id, name, homepage_url and license, ordered by id, up to limit (default 50, maximum 100); no pagination. Use for attribution or source selection, not data retrieval or freshness checks. Use list_topics to choose a data tool and catalog for service capabilities. Existing data responses already include citations; this extra call is optional. Approval is an internal source policy, not independent factual verification. An empty list means no approved source entries were returned.
name: list_sources
